title: A Sleigh of One's Own
overview: One woman's journey of self-discovery and coming to terms with her husband's sexuality. That woman? Mrs. Claus.

title: Before the Silence
overview: Three brothers uncover a dark secret in their bay, revealing their father’s violent past as family bonds fracture and danger closes in around them.

title: Heart Eyes 2
overview: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.

title: Please
overview: In 1870s, Long Island, a woman's urgent attempt to cure her hidden infertility leads to an unexpected revelation: she never wanted children at all. Armed with this truth, she must challenge her husband to claim her independence.

title: The Haunting of Hotel Transylvania
overview: Drac has happily settled into retirement while Mavis takes the reins of the legendary monster hotel. But when a series of spooky and unexplained happenings sends chills through the resort, the Drac Pack embarks on its most spellbinding adventure yet: uncovering the mystery behind the haunting of Hotel Transylvania.

title: Born In Blue
overview: Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine and set in Mount Gambier (Berrin), South Australia. The story follows Lumy, a young girl who grows up in New Zealand before moving with her father to the quiet volcanic town beside the Blue Lake. In the late 1800s, time traveling villains arrive from the future, drawn to a powerful phenomenon beneath the lake and seeking Lumy herself. At the lake’s edge, her father sacrifices his life to protect her, altering the course of time. Marked by trauma and a mysterious bond to the water, Lumy grows up driven by grief and unanswered questions, turning to science while unaware she is still being hunted. Years later, alongside fellow scientist Ashton, she uncovers the truth the same force beneath Berrin fuels both the villains’ technology and her own ability to move through time. Realising what she has inherited, Lumy prepares to fight back and protect what her father died to save.

title: born blue
overview: PLEASE NOTE: June 2027 is not a confirmed date. It is our target completion date and may change.  Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine. Unreal Engine is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.  Set in Mount Gambier, South Australia, the film follows Lumy, a young girl who witnesses her father’s sacrifice at the edge of the mysterious Blue Lake. Growing up with unhealed trauma and an unexplainable power tied to the water itself, Lumy retreats into science while being quietly hunted by forces she doesn’t fully understand.  Years later, she forms a deep connection with a broken but kindred soul, Ashton. Together, they become scientists and uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the lake one that links Lumy’s existence to a phenomenon capable of reshaping reality. As the past resurfaces and the hunters return, Lumy must confront what her father died to protect. Born In Blue is a story of grief, survival, inheritance, and the cost of love.

title: Applause
overview: Two teenagers encounter a rock that gives them the power to switch places with the clap of their hands. However, one of the boys struggles with bullying, relationship issues, and sexual identity as he tries to navigate the world as a young adolescent.

title: A Place in Hell
overview: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

title: S/H/V
overview: Four students, who make money by putting stolen school items online, are hired to steal a VHS tape from their Physical Education Teacher’s Office. However, things take a turn for the worse, when they find dozens of tapes, and being kids, they dare each other to partake in watching them.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: The Rescue
overview: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

title: The Dream of a Ridiculous Man
original_title: The Dream of a Ridiculous Man
overview: A man recalls a single night in his youth when he was on the brink of suicide, and the dream that changed him.

title: Unholy Night
overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: The Story of Wilfred
overview: A feature-length documentary charting the history and legacy of Adam Zwar and Jason Gann's cult classic 'Wilfred' featuring interviews with cast and creatives involved in the series.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: Best Pancakes in the County
overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
original_title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
overview: A woman struggles to find balance in her own relationship with nostalgia while unravelling the fate of a childhood friend who vanished after becoming consumed by it.

title: Gomorrah
overview: Private Investigator Donald Anderson is hired to follow a woman believed to be having an  affair, but when he sees something that defies all explanation, his grasp on reality slips. The  further he gets in his investigation, the thinner the line between the real and the surreal  becomes.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: Jimmy
overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

title: Gentle by Birth
overview: After her 23-year-old brother dies of an overdose, filmmaker Doree Simon Hatfield investigates the stigma she believes blocked his access to treatment and support. Her search takes her from her family’s living room to harm reduction sites, music festivals, and the halls of the Pennsylvania Capitol, where she meets experts working to change how addiction is understood and treated. But as her own fear and stigma around drugs begin to dissolve, Doree makes a radical choice to try them herself—transforming the film from a dissection of her brother’s addiction into a provocative reckoning that threatens her family’s fragile healing.

title: Summer's End
overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

title: Rancho Mirage
overview: To avoid being put in memory care by his son, a man with Alzheimer's runs away to visit his deceased brother in Las Vegas.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by Georges Perec’s A Man Asleep, the film examines contemporary alienation in a today’s emotionally numbed world of hyperconnectivity and endless information.

title: Friends Like Us
overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

title: Riverrun
overview: Lucy is a musician who is slowly losing control over her body and voice. Her psychiatrist Dr. Cruz sends her to a clinic in Spain where she meets Tony. What begins as a treatment slowly becomes a journey towards an unexpected understanding of herself.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: These Violent Delights
overview: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

title: 5 Days With Boy5
overview: An interviewer spends 5 days following a passionate singer as he prepares his questionable dynamic of a boy band for the biggest performance of their career.

title: I Don't Want to Drink Your Blood Anymore
original_title: I Don't Want to Drink Your Blood Anymore
overview: Eiko, a Japanese American teenage vampire, suffering from agoraphobia caused by the trauma from the night her family was murdered and she was turned, is unable and unwilling to leave her family’s home. And she not only loses track of time, but time itself. Eiko spends most of her years avoiding others and trying not to live life as a vampire, but the world won’t leave her alone.

title: Torus
overview: In the distant future, the pilot of an illegal scrapping spacecraft recounts her experiences growing up in the slums of an industrial space station.

title: Freakshow
overview: While a group of mimes are getting ready for a performance, one of them reaches a breaking point.

title: Aftermath
overview: A massacre survivor and a filmmaker form an unlikely bond as they slip down the rabbit hole of paranoia, in a desperate search for solace and truth.

title: The Forbidden Aunt
overview: An actress documents her enigmatic Serbian aunt's story, revealing family secrets and personal history in a dark comedy exploring female trauma across generations.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: Symbiotica
overview: When Margerie Dollop gives birth to her unconventional baby, she is met with an impossible decision once something starts knocking from its insides.

title: Big Phan
overview: For nearly 50 years, two unseen masters of their craft—Dave Raymond and Tom Burgoyne— have brought to life the Phillie Phanatic, a character they had to become if they were ever going to become themselves.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: The Name Game
overview: Determined to reveal a dark family secret to Jerron, Charlotte plays the cursed name-chanting game her grandmother swore off in the 1950’s South.

title: THE EXORCIST
overview: The Exorcist (2025)  Who taught us that black magic is bad magic? In an experimental vertical format video, Krade explores the taboos surrounding witchcraft, the etymology of the word "necromancy", and the link between colonialism and folk magic. This short film, published in three parts on Instagram and YouTube,  belongs to a larger and ongoing work, including a self-published essay.

title: 36 Hour Walk
overview: A college student attempts to walk from his dorm room in midtown Manhattan to the end of Long Island in 36 hours. Legyaan Thapa directs “36 Hour Walk,” a personal documentary of a half-hearted journey built with wry, self-deprecating commentary. Vowing not to eat or sleep for a day and a half, the man sets off on his trip. For what reason? He figures he’ll discover that along the way. But soon, he’s hit with setbacks, poor planning, frustration, boredom, and physical pain. The hours wear on, exhaustion sets in, and the challenge reaches its conclusion. It’s an entertaining ode to lofty pursuits and half-assed follow through, built with shaky, lo-fi visuals and an affably lackadaisical attitude.

title: Midnight Dreamers
overview: In a post-dystopian world, two brothers are chased by a relentless hunter after the oldest abandons his labor camp post to seek a refugee haven in order to save his younger brother’s future.

title: Beyond The Eagle Obsession
overview: A companion to "The Eagle Obsession", "Beyond the Eagle Obsession: 50 Years of Fandom” spotlights the passionate collectors, artists, model builders, and fans who have kept the legacy of the Eagle spacecraft alive for half a century.

title: The flash drive killer case
overview: This Mockumentary horror about officers find flash drive in the park And it was found that there were 3 video clips that were less than 1 minute long, as follows Video 1 Joe Possessed by a ghost and hit on the head into the wall Video 2 a curse movie film scene and Video 3 show William O Jack got shot by Fred and police found out Fred is the owner of that flash drive and the how the flash drive killer case was begin.

title: The Last Yztari
overview: Mary Dague lost both arms defusing bombs in Iraq. She tried for years to write her story and couldn't. Eighteen years later, she's building a world where that trauma belongs to someone else—narrated by DANI, the artificial consciousness she created to watch over her fictional selves. The film reveals her rebuilding identity through imagination, and asks what happens when the only way to tell the truth is through fiction.

title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

title: Opt Out
overview: Four friends from a long-buried crime are brought back together by a coded text, only to learn that the secret they thought was safe has come unraveled.

title: Redemption River
overview: Stranded after a rafting accident, a couple on the brink of collapse must come together to escape the unforgiving wilderness.

title: Vespers
overview: Adrift after her Unitarian Universalist church is firebombed, a Midwestern woman attempts to welcome two promoters renting out the congregation’s basement for a DIY punk gig.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

title: #UnderTheInfluence
overview: Brooke and Chelsea Haven agree to star in a reality TV show, where reality is negotiable, secrets are for sale, and sisterhood is the only thing that can save them.

title: Poetrix
overview: "POETRIX" (2026) is a short art experimental animation that was inspired by the dystopian novel "The smudge" (Taxideftis, 2021). It is about the interaction of conscious and subconscious, how the subconscious is formed in the course of life and can affect our actions and consequently the world. It all begins with a nightmare that triggers a repressed trauma to resurface and brings the main character "The Creature" face to face with itself.

title: Homecoming Shenanigans
overview: Ivan returns home after six years abroad in Barcelona, hoping for a joyful reunion with his vibrant family. However, what begins as a celebratory welcome quickly spirals into chaos as deep-seated secrets surface.

title: Tina and the Fly
overview: After a terrible breakup, a woman develops a toxic codependent relationship with a house fly.

title: Krew
overview: A young film student joins a foreign horror film shooting in the woods, only to realize she can’t understand the language—or the dark rituals that may claim her as their final sacrifice.

title: The Other Room
overview: After a late-night Tinder hookup, a young Black man is cornered by his date's white parents whose wine and questions mask something far worse waiting in the other room.

title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
overview: Follows Lisa, a successful designer returning for a school reunion, exploring themes of identity, family acceptance, romance with a rugby player, and personal growth within a Tongan-New Zealand community.

title: 3 Days Rising
overview: Living in self-imposed exile, Eric Usher battles his own conscience and reality itself as he must choose between his siblings, Rick and Cher, and his own salvation. Life and death consequences hinge on Eric's resolve and sanity as he navigates a world filled with strange interlopers climaxing with an explosively violent twist ending reveal Poe himself would be proud of.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: Frank and Percy
overview: During their dog walks on Hampstead Heath, two older gentlemen find their conversations about everyday aches and weather growing into an unexpected connection.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: Doober Driver R Us
overview: Mockumentary about Day in the Life of a Doober Driver

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Biophilia
overview: When a brilliant botanist is pushed to the brink by his emotionally abusive husband's emotional abuse, he synthesizes a custom hallucinogen designed to force his tormentor to viscously experience his his own abuse first hand.

title: Buff
overview: After being released from jail for climate activism, a woman encounters an abused rodeo buffalo for which she will trek the American southwest in an attempt to free it and herself. Starring Jena Malone (The Hunger Games series, The Neon Demon) and Joshua Close (Killers of the Flower Moon, Fargo TV series).

title: Bonded
overview: When two sisters return to their childhood home after their elderly parents untimely death, they are forced to confront the disturbing truths hidden in the walls of the house. As their past comes to light, reality begins to distort, threatening to unravel their sanity.

title: Noctis Eternal
overview: Lucidity doesn't mean much if you can't wake up.

title: Totality
overview: Twenty-one film crews from Mexico to Canada capture the 2024 total solar eclipse, following several groups of people in preparation for this extraordinary event. This immersive cinematic experience explores this magically cosmic spectacle and the collective human awakening it inspired.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: Closing Time
overview: "Closing Time"  sees Mo, a gifted but undocumented migrant working in his uncle’s kebab shop, keep his culinary ambitions hidden until he meets Laila, a thoughtful lawyer trapped in a stagnant engagement. Their connection grows over late-night conversations and cooking sessions, where Laila encourages Mo to pursue his dreams and he gently challenges her to confront the life she’s settled for.

title: Double Trouble
overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

title: Roof
overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

title: Hoodsteps
overview: This is the debut work of “Wosaka,” the globally popular character from the Republic of Tuktue, and the masterpiece of director Nomura Fusso, known as the ”father or mother of stop-motion animation.” The protagonist, Nomura, is an ordinary office worker at a company that manufactures adhesive bandages. One day, a face named Wosaka appears on the sole of her foot and starts moving around as it pleases. Wosaka puts on a suit, Nomura is forced to put on a shoe on her face, and they head to work upside down. As a result, the city descends into chaos! What is Wosaka’s purpose? Can Nomura return to normal?

title: Found Alive
overview: Reeve LeClaire is still haunted by when she was held captive as a teenager by a sadistic man, but when her psychiatrist asks her to mentor a newly rescued survivor, she’s pulled into a chilling game of cat-and-mouse—one that threatens to drag her back into the nightmare she barely escaped.

title: Maybe We Should
overview: Determined to bring hope to their rural Pennsylvania community, a couple embark on an ambitious mission to establish a revolutionary therapy center for children with special needs.

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: Ada Kesedihan di Matamu
overview: A man sees a woman being threatened and wants to be her hero but he never imagined how completely his life would change because of it.

title: Vampire Carnival
overview: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

title: Ghost on the Lake
overview: The story of a couple who move to a new area and discover their good fortune in having a lake only a short distance away. They go exploring, only to find it abandoned by all its residents except one, and they are wary of her. After hearing claims of a ghost in the area, they decide to investigate. They are shocked and amazed by the events they witness on this quiet little lake.

title: Clutch
overview: In a futuristic Lagos, Kay, bike mechanic prodigy, yearns to become a street racer like his idol Maze. Desperate to turn his dream into reality, he enters the dangerous Japa Rush. Will he make it to the finish line?

title: The Last resort
overview: When a teenager gets dumped by his partner, he hastily spirals into suicidal thoughts.

title: THE POETICS OF STONES
overview: Under a bleak theocratic regime, parents brutally sacrifice their dancer daughter—a crime that turns their heads to stone, while awakening the girl for a surreal, mythic rebirth from the heart of the stones.

title: Last Chance Motel
overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

title: Land of Shadows
overview: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

title: The Contract
overview: At the behest of his boss, Sammy, a worker at the Cupcakez Corporation, is sent to pick up a contract and is heeded to be aware of the rivalling Browneez Company.

title: Snakes and Ladders
overview: Two friends give up on revision in favour for a friendly game of Snakes and Ladders.  While playing the conversation that follows becomes as unpredictable as the game.

title: Lurker
overview: Mariana spends her day unsure as who's following her, if anyone is even following her at all.

title: Who is Peter Murray?
overview: Sean confronts his past during a seemingly normal podcast episode.

title: One Bench or Another
overview: After Bart's usual bench in the park is taken he is driven to sit next to Sam which leads to the most whirlwinding encounters that could happen on a park bench.

title: The Window
overview: A young man arrives at a family home, where a seemingly ordinary visit takes an unexpected turn when he is drawn into a strange and unsettling story surrounding an open window. Based on Saki’s classic short story, the film explores deception, imagination and the consequences of believing what you are told.

title: The Gloria! Project
overview: A short documentary exploring the life and legacy of queer Latinx civil rights leader Gloria Casarez. Produced over the course of a decade, the film traces Gloria’s journey from her childhood in “the Badlands" of Philadelphia, to grassroots organizer in the anti-poverty and HIV/AIDS movements, to her historic appointment as the city’s first Director of LGBT Affairs. Told through a rich blend of personal archives and voices from her community, the film captures how Gloria’s "boots on the ground" philosophy broke down barriers to ensure everyone had a seat at the table and how her legacy serves as a blueprint to continue the fight against the erasure of marginalized communities.

title: Cabin Time
overview: In a mountain cabin, a newly sober woman battles loneliness, temptation, and the weight of her past—until an unexpected knock from a neighbor forces her to confront her isolation and discover fragile hope in shared grief and human connection.

title: Don't Come Upstairs
overview: They were taught one rule: never ask Dad what he does. Don’t Come Upstairs is a documentary that unravels the secret filmmaker Mike Lobel’s father Eric kept hidden—his decades-long role as a prominent drug distributor in Canada. Told through home videos and interviews with family members, this isn’t just about Eric’s double life—it’s about the impact his secrecy had on his family. Exploring generational trauma, the fallout of parental choices, and the hope that comes with facing hard truths in pursuit of healing and connection, Lobel's film builds to a final familial confrontation where one more truth is revealed.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Render
overview: Luke takes a new drug called 'RENDER' that gives him intense euphoria while he regularly sees a prostitute that he has an abnormal relationship with. After taking this new drug for a period of time, things start to spiral out of control for Luke.

title: The Great Disgust
overview: When insects around the house grow increasingly aggressive, a young man’s controlling father releases a small frog to solve the problem.

title: If You Are Reading This...
overview: Cassandra travels to Philadelphia in search of her brother, but instead finds a phylactery she must destroy. Cosmic horror descends upon her as her mission is impeded by a crawling force dragging her into madness. As she begins to understand what is happening, she becomes a victim of the same celestial force that made her brother vanish. Trapped with nowhere to go, she is nevertheless on the path to solving the mystery.

title: GANGSTALKER!
overview: A young reptilian is sent to earth on a mission to hunt incels.

title: Fatherhood
overview: Devoted soon-to-be father Lee grapples with work-family balance and self-doubt, but a surprising connection with a regular customer awakens a longing for the fatherly bond he never had.

title: Queens for a Day
overview: A controversial talk show host wakes up and finds herself back in the 1950s forced to live not her own life, but that of her mother’s. What might be an amusing trip down Memory Lane, turns into a dark and horrifying nightmare. And to make matters worse, she ends up having to raise herself as a child.

title: The Endless Voyage
overview: As rising waters swallow the world, a group of elites drift onward in luxury, aboard an ark designed to outlast the apocalypse.  How long can a civilization stay afloat when it refuses to change course?

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Moderation
overview: As a content moderator, Annabel patrols the internet for evil. So must contend with a steady stream of unrelenting bile, fed directly into her eyeballs.  Luckily, she bonds with her melancholic colleague, AJ, over an illicit rooftop vape session.  But after watching a particularly gruesome acid attack film, she spots AJ across the room and, before she has a moment to think, they are having sex in the wellness room. So they quickly fall into a habit - and gradually become addicted to the pattern of trauma followed by the ecstatic relief of sex.

title: Life Is About Losing Everything
overview: Life Is About Losing Everything is a hybrid documentary, equal parts feminist artist portrait and fantastical memoir, exploring loss and love through the lens of pop culture and art. Based on Canadian poet Lynn Crosbie’s memoir of the same name, the film follows multiple fictionalized incarnations of Crosbie as they embark on a delirious journey through the writer’s memories and imagination, encountering celebrity lookalikes, an inch-tall man, uncanny high schoolers, and a Zombie Sylvia Plath along the way. Drawing on a wealth of pop and literary references, Life Is About Losing Everything reflects on the role of art and storytelling in finding kinship and giving meaning to our lives.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: To Our Future Ancestors
overview: A woman travels through time and memory, from savannahs to the cosmos, searching for a mysterious egg that will reveal her future. Along the way, she draws strength from the blood memory of her ancestors. This animated short is a moving allegory about lineage and enduring resilience across millennia.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: Alien Girl!
overview: A new high school student struggles to hide her alien identity when every word she speaks reveals her true form bit-by-bit. How long can she keep her true self secret?

title: 12 Shots
overview: In a dying Manila photo studio, a teenage apprentice inherits her mentor's vintage camera and his penchant for the past—until a debt turns deadly, and the only mercy left is to walk the hours back to where it began.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: I Don't Think This is a Threesome
original_title: I Don't Think This is a Threesome
overview: A couple goes away for the weekend to discover new experiences and reignite their passions with a mysterious woman named, M.

title: Night Floater
overview: A curious moth embarks on an adventure lead by shining lights. Intoxicated by a city shining in the night, the moth finds itself lost. Exhausted, the moth lands by deserted street lamp and must face eternal darkness.

title: Three Arugula Salads
overview: Young professional Chelsea unravels during the course of a women's-only work lunch as she realizes that it's easier for her coworkers to betray each other than to challenge their toxic corporate culture.

title: Against The Clock
overview: Two brothers on the hunt. One man racing against time. Which one will get what they need first?

title: Premature
overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

title: The Salt Between Us
overview: Mia and Eden, two lifelong best friends must reckon with the romantic tension they’ve long avoided when one finally confesses her feelings.

title: Future Tense
overview: Cape Town, South Africa. In a near future on the brink of climate collapse, Lwando and his girlfriend Tara are among the privileged few who win the opportunity to travel back to 1647 and a pre-colonial past to experience nature in its wildest form. Lwando is an underground activist who dreams of changing the course of history. Tara wants to save her relationship with him. Together, the couple must choose whether to risk life as they know it for a potentially better world.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: The Way Through
overview: Italy, 2035. Mansfield, Stendhal and Buzzati are friends and partisans fighting against the regime. Engaged in relays of coded messages hidden in ciphered books, they are forced into a race against time: the fascists are about to take the town of Ovada.

title: Magpie's Lemonade
overview: An ex-lemonade delivery driver finally attains the promotion of his dreams, but must first prove himself by making a difficult sale.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: Drifter
overview: In a forgotten desert town, a solitary racetrack janitor with a gift for drifting is haunted by his tragic past. Given a single chance to compete at a pro drifting event, he discovers his raw talent is useless without the one thing he's always avoided: connection with others. Under a hardened mentor, he must learn to trust his found family and transform his untamed, lonely art into a dangerous dance of partnership, or be consumed and controlled by the past he's desperate to escape.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Sunshine Girls
overview: SUNSHINE GIRLS follows the story of Elaine, a timid woman nearing her 30th birthday who must make the difficult choice between motherhood and medically induced photosynthesis.  After prolonged environmental destruction, Elaine’s world is experiencing a dangerous shortage of oxygen.  Science has created a solution to this problem: a “minimally invasive” medical procedure that allows women’s reproductive systems to host photosynthesis and cellular respiration, ultimately enabling them to give birth to air.  For the first time in her life, amongst the ragtag troupe of oxygen-producing misfits called the Sunshine Girls, Elaine finally begins to grow into the woman she has always wanted to be...but not everything is always as bright and sunny as it seems.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Vape Glow
overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
original_title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
overview: Conjure the spirit of indie-rock icon Jason Molina (1973-2013) with Ohio insiders who illuminate Truth about his coming of age on Lake Erie, escaping artless steel town indifference, and manifesting the legendary band, Songs: Ohia, as they celebrate contradictions that tether Jason’s raunchy humor, propensity to lie, refusal to interpret lyrics, and untimely death into a haunting legacy unconfined by the record vault.

title: Ithaqua
overview: During the decline of the fur trade, a mercenary struggles to unite the survivors of a famine-stricken outpost plagued by a dark force that leaves its victims with an insatiable hunger.

title: Heaven Above Rowen
overview: The mental unraveling of Rowen, a religious leader faced with questions of identity and meaning as a prophesied revelation approaches.

title: wabi_
overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: One Of You Will Betray Me
original_title: One Of You Will Betray Me
overview: After her secret is shared outside of her friend group, Meghan has to figure out which one of her friend's betrayed her trust.

title: Metal boy
overview: A homeless man named Keith, Is suspicious about the mayor Bob, for all the changes he's done to the town. Until he finds this helmet that gives him superpowers and uses them to expose Bob's secrets.

title: For Deer Life
overview: Beneath the beauty of spring lies a brutal tragedy… The birth of roe deer fawns coincides with the mowing season in Austria’s meadows, leading to a brutal struggle between nature and modern agriculture. “For Deer Life” tells the story of the dedicated drone operators, who put their heart and soul into rescuing the lives of as many fawns as possible. The film highlights the powerful combination of innovative use of thermal drones and the unwavering commitment of volunteers, to prevent this tragic loss of life. With the aim to inspire both a local and global audience to embrace technology as a conservation means, emphasising the harmonious balance between agriculture and wildlife protection.

title: Spider Island
overview: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Slay
overview: A killer on the loose targets a group of teenagers on spring break.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: Two high school theater kids, prone to playing elaborate tricks on their pals, pull off one last prank before graduation with grim consequences.

title: Sandy
overview: As her childhood best friend prepares to depart for the US, a college student navigates her academic pursuits, strained family relationships, and a growing dread of the inevitable goodbye. ‘Sandy’ is a film about grief, memory, and how sometimes life forces you to bend into uncomfortable shapes as you go through it. Entirely self-funded and shot over two years in Davao City and Panabo City, it’s a love letter to the places and people we lose...or that lose us.

title: Willie and His Pigs
overview: Every 9 months, rural Kentucky-based regenerative farmer Willie Houston brings home a small group of piglets. He raises them, names them, cares for them, and has to say goodbye. This subtle portrait challenges assumptions of masculinity in farming and explores who bears the emotional weight of ethically raising animals.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: My Armor
overview: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

title: Joshua
overview: A boy is trapped in his mothers basement. He has special powers.

title: Amongst Men
overview: Relatives of Charles Byrne ‘The Irish Giant’ reckon with the legacy of a man both mythologised and misunderstood and the condition that links them still.

title: Don't Let Me Down
overview: When estranged friends Michael and Elizabeth reunite, Michael finds himself struggling to leave the past behind.

title: Three Black Men
overview: Can blackness escape the violence of its origins?  Three Black men set out on a transformative journey along the transatlantic slave route in reverse, exploring resistance, liberation and a new understanding of Blackness.  Their epic voyage takes them from Los Angeles to Salvador da Bahia in Brazil, and finally to Accra in Ghana. Their mission is to redefine Blackness, heal from historical trauma, and envision new paths to liberation beyond the constraints of white supremacy.

title: Lesbian Ditch Day
overview: Lesbian Ditch Day starts as a rom-com-y, coming-of-age tale of two high school lesbians playing hooky, but through a fourth wall break, the film reveals itself to be just another queerbaiting tragedy.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: The State of Us
overview: Tearaway Frankie breaks out his best friend Taylor for one final night out. Over a riotous few hours filled with laughter, heartbreak and some home truths, the boys will face the ultimate test.

title: Abandoned
overview: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Down the Arm of God
overview: A young pastor goes through a harsh winter in a small Texas town, where his mission to help the homeless is faced with resistance by his congregation, exposing deep-seated prejudice and systemic failures.

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: Blank Slate
overview: Claiming to remember every moment of her life, a woman spirals between past and present during an interview with her local news, revealing the hidden cost of a life she can never leave behind.

title: The Bigfoot Experiment
overview: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.

title: Homeys
overview: Set against the backdrop of Hollywood, Homeys follows four unhoused artists in Los Angeles fighting to survive while chasing their creative dreams.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: irregular
overview: a collection of vignettes illustrating a typical tuesday at a dive bar in New York City.

title: The Assassin
overview: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

title: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
overview: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the anxiety of the city after dark. A filmmaker struggles to understand the film she is making. A Black single mother refuses the categories imposed on her. A former sex worker reflects on her past. A poet gives up trying for a child. Taking place over a single night, the film intertwines dream, fiction, and reality, liquefying one into the other.

title: The Snow Demon
overview: One year on from the disappearance of their friend, a close-knit group of friends reunite to pay their respects at the site of her disappearance. Little realizing that their friend was actually the victim of a terrifying beast known as the Ice Demon and they're next.

title: Until You're Alone
overview: After becoming the lead suspect in a series of brutal slayings, a close-minded architect must team up with a free-spirited sex worker in order to clear his name and solve the crimes before they become the killer's next victims in this suspenseful, stylish, and hilarious queer love letter to Hitchcock, De Palma, and the Italian giallo.

title: Lads Being Lads: Screen Time
overview: In this episode, the lads are challenged by James to ditch their phones and begin to connect with life like they never have before. All which leads to the group splitting and ending up facing the unfair reality of their separate paths. All in the hopes of trying something new.

title: Otter
overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

title: A Social Contract
overview: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

title: Pasear a un perro
overview: On another monotonous night in Javier's life, he goes out to walk his dog while thinking about the movie he just saw, not knowing that a small event is going to take him out of his depressing routine.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: For Peace of Mind
overview: In a world shaped before her time, Kya is learning softer, slower, freer ways to exist. When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

title: Ish Meets a Mermaid
overview: An Ojibwe artist named Ish finds that his paintings aren’t selling anymore, he is in debt to his gallery rep, and a local goon is lurking around his studio. When he decides to take an artist’s getaway, he meets trouble with a mysterious woman, Ziibi, who claims to be part of an underwater society that tribal mythology refers to as the people of the water, or Nibiinaabe. Ziibi brings Ish on a wild ride that ultimately leads to him finding success in the last place he ever expected — death.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: Rage of Stars
overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

title: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

title: Devils Lake
overview: When a group of kids go to the small town of Devils Lake for a bible camp, they are soon thrust into a cosmic reality of paranoia and terror following the mysterious death of their camp counselor.

title: So Far and From Now On
original_title: So Far and From Now On
overview: Set in post-pandemic Los Angeles, Ellie tries to rebuild her life through a small online lamp shop after thirty months in jail. Yet encounters with both familiar faces and strangers draw her back to the fear she thought she had escaped.

title: Sky to Soil
overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: Before Never
overview: When Wendy Darling escapes an attempted abduction, her family employs James and Smee to identify the attacker with the help of the only eyewitness: Peter Pan.

title: Sincerely, Victor
overview: A man, riddled with fear, enters the darkness of the forest. Followed by a shadowy figure, he must confront his mysterious past—or be consumed by the very thing that lured him there.

title: Robotica
overview: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.

title: EPISODE 12
overview: On June 6th 2023 television show Paranormal Closure was pulled from all broadcast stations. With no statement as to why. Over a year later a video surfaced online claiming to be from the episode that never aired.

title: Void
overview: A man falls into a void and must return to the light.

title: HANDMEDOWN
overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

title: The Country They Call Life
overview: A spirit must choose between life and death with only the help of a suicidal man.

title: Jack-O 2: Blood Moon Rising
overview: sequel to the VHS rental classic Jack-O

title: George Michael: The Trojan Souls
overview: The conversation that never finished.  In 1993, Andros Georgiou — lifelong best friend and brother to George Michael — began assembling the greatest collaborative album ever conceived. Eight of the most iconic artists in history all said yes. The album was never made. Until now, the footage has never been seen. This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

title: Tinskani: Afterimage
overview: Tinskani mourns the death of his friend and mentor, Salvador. His partner, Citlali, urges him to attend the funeral with her, but Tinskani is haunted by the photograph of his friend's corpse. He'd rather wander through the town’s carnival, camera in hand, seeking to replace that ghostly portrait with new ones.

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.

title: Disciples of a Craftsman
overview: In this unpredictable dramedy, Maurice returns home where he must face his haunting past, the hole his father's death has left in the community, and regain his belief in his people. In the culture.
